angel_island_pow_note.png.title: File:A note left by a Japanese prisoner of war held at Angel Island during World War II.png
angel_island_pow_note.png.desc: DPLA: "A photograph of a note left by a Japanese prisoner of war held at Angel Island during World War II: This photograph of an exhibit at Angel Island State Park shows a note left by a Japanese prisoner of war (POW), and a panel translating the note to English for park visitors. The POW wrote the note on the wall before he returned to Japan on November 7, 1945—two months after Japan surrendered.
